newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Genbel to distribute "A" shares.
newsitem.headline: Genbel to distribute "A" shares.

text.p: Genbel South Africa Ltd said on Tuesday it would distribute the portfolio underpinning its 393.8 million "A" shares following appropriate legislative changes.
Genbel will now distribute shares in Commercial Union of South Africa Ltd, Illovo Sugar Ltd, Imperial Holdings Ltd (South Africa) Ltd, McCarthy Group Ltd and Norwich Holdings Ltd.
Other Genbel holdings were distributed at the time of the group's partial unbundling in May this year.
Qualifying shareholders will also receive a cash dividend of 1.48 cents per "A" share, representing dividends received on the portfolio over the six month life of the "A" shares.
The last day to register for the "A" share distribution is November 1.
